body.en: Primary *functions*: accepting deposits (current accounts for businesses, savings accounts for individuals, fixed deposits for a period at higher interest, recurring deposits for regular savings) and lending (loans, cash credit, overdraft and discounting of bills of exchange). Secondary functions: agency functions (collecting cheques and dividends, paying bills, buying and selling securities on customers' instructions) and general utility functions (lockers, issuing drafts and letters of credit, credit cards, foreign exchange). By lending, banks also create credit.

body.en: *E-banking* means banking services delivered electronically: internet banking, mobile banking, ATMs and debit cards, and electronic fund transfers such as NEFT (in batches), RTGS (real-time, for large amounts), IMPS (instant, round the clock) and UPI (instant payments from a mobile phone using a virtual address). Benefits: 24 × 7 service, anywhere banking, lower costs, speed, a record of every transaction and fewer cash-handling risks. Users must guard against phishing and fraud: never share OTPs or PINs.

say.en: Find the maturity value of a fixed deposit of 50,000 rupees at 8 percent a year, compounded annually, for 3 years.
Value equals 50,000 times 1.08^3.
Value equals 50,000 times 1.259712 equals 62,985.60 rupees.
Interest earned equals 12,985.60 rupees.
So the answer is 62,985.60 rupees.
